messages:
acme_ops: Hey team — starting ~09:01 UTC we saw a wave of 503s and client timeouts hitting our hosted inference routes. Happening across multiple regions (usw2, eu-west1). Request id: req_0a7b3f. Short repro below.

acme_ops: repro steps:
- curl to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
- Authorization: Bearer <token>
- payload: {"model": "rwd-3-large", "prompt": "<~4k tokens>"}
- concurrency: 80 concurrent streams

acme_ops: noticed SDK kept retrying and we were charged for retries. any idea?

emma_support: thanks for the report, @acme_ops — sorry about the hit. I'm escalating to oncall. Can you paste the exact curl you used (redact token) and the SDK + version? Also approximate p95 latency before this started. :wave:

acme_ops: sure — curl below (token redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3-large","prompt":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":1200}' \
  # run 80 concurrent processes via k6
```
SDK: native-js v2.4.1. p95 pre-incident ~420ms; during wave requests either 503 or hang until client timeout (30s).

raj_oncall: pinged. Looking at gateway logs now — can you confirm whether you enabled connection pooling/keepalive in the SDK config? Also did you rotate tokens recently?

acme_ops: keepalive default in SDK; we did a token rotate around 08:50 but that was single-run and seemed fine.

marta_enginfra: grabbing gateway traces for req_0a7b3f and nearby IDs. Early glance shows a burst of connection resets on the edge LB around 09:01:12. Sample gateway log: 
```
[edge-gw] 2026-03-14T09:01:12Z req=req_0a7b3f upstream=10.4.9.12:8080 status=503 code=ECONNRESET conn_id=2345 latency=1187ms
[upstream] 2026-03-14T09:01:12Z worker=inf-12 error=ETIMEDOUT kvcache_wait=450ms
```

marta_enginfra: looks like worker-side KV cache lock contention + upstream timeouts when sequences are long. We'll pull more traces.

deploy-bot: deployment rwd-runtime/2026-03-14T08:45 -> canary -> completed at 08:46 UTC on usw2 (no errors reported).

raj_oncall: temporary mitigation steps for customer: 1) reduce concurrency to 10-20, 2) set SDK max_retries=1 and enable exponential backoff, 3) try model variant rwd-3-medium which has smaller KV working set. Can you try and report?

acme_ops: will try switching to rwd-3-medium and reduce to 20 concurrent. ETA 10m.

kevin_cs: keeping @acme_ops updated externally — will send a short note about temporary throttling and that we're investigating root cause. :memo:

sre-bot: Alert — hosted-inference SLO error rate crossed 3% threshold in usw2 at 09:00:58 UTC. Paging oncall.

acme_ops: after switching to rwd-3-medium + concurrency 20 we see successful responses again, p95 ~680ms, no 503s in last 2 minutes. Thanks.

marta_enginfra: confirmed customer traffic steady and inf workers showing less KV lock waits. We have saved traces and will run postmortem. Preliminary hypothesis: a combination of long sequences causing KV cache thrashing + connection resets at edge under high concurrency.

raj_oncall: follow up action items:
- eng-infra to investigate KV cache lock scaling and add metrics (marta)
- runtime to add heuristic to reject extremely large concurrent long-context requests with a clear 429/Retry-After (raj)
- support to coordinate customer comms and billing shield evaluation (kevin)
- infra to correlate edge LB resets with autoscaler events (marta)

emma_support: @acme_ops — we'll keep you updated. If you want, we can apply a temporary billing credit for retry charges while we root cause. Please open a support ticket with the sample request ids you have.

acme_ops: appreciate it. I'll open the ticket and attach request ids and k6 run logs. Thanks for speedy triage. :pray:

marta_enginfra: saved full trace bundle to infra S3: s3://redwood-traces/2026-03-14/1767771234-trace-bundle.zip — will include in the postmortem.

raj_oncall: leaving this assigned to eng-infra for RCA, will keep oncall looped for any regressions. Closing slack thread once postmortem links posted.

emma_support: internal note: ticket #SUP-3217 created for ACME, tagging billing-review for retry-charge shield.

acme_ops: thanks all.
